messages.text:
The client build is successful and backend tests are green; only the SSR server bundle still fails on a TanStack package export mismatch.

I’m inspecting the installed Router export map and Start SSR import expectations now, then I’ll patch the version alignment or entry import that causes `@tanstack/react-router/ssr/server` to be resolved.
